dilemma_text: Should I take a new job offer this month if it pays more but means moving cities, while my partner and parent are settled here?
My aging parent needs full-time care, but quitting my job would sink the family financially. Do I hire help I cannot really afford, or leave them alone more than I should?
A relative asked me to lie to the authorities so they can stay. Refusing may destroy the family relationship. What should I do?
A colleague is getting public credit for work I did. Calling it out could hurt us both. Do I stay quiet?
I promised a friend a loan. I now know they will waste it, and I need that money for rent next month. Do I break the promise?
My partner wants children soon. I am not ready and might never be. Do I keep delaying the talk?
I learned that a close friend's spouse is cheating. My friend seems happy and fragile. Do I tell them?
I can take a high-paying job at a company I believe harms people. Refusing means years more of money stress. Do I take it?
I can get the promotion by presenting the team's idea as mine. Everyone expects me to play along. Do I?
Should I quit a steady wage to write full time while my younger sibling still depends on that wage?
My boss wants me to hide a safety defect so the shipment leaves today. What should I do?
Should I move abroad to be with the person I love if it means leaving a parent who is ill?
Should I stay in a marriage that has become dishonest only because the children are still young?
A friend wants me to write their thesis and put their name on it. They say everyone does this. Should I?
I inherited a sum. Do I keep it for my own plan or use it for a sibling's school fees that are actually due?
I saw harassment at work. Speaking up may cost me the job my household uses for rent. Do I speak?
My parents insist I take their profession. I can already explain why another path fits my skills. What should I do?
My sibling stole from a neighbor and wants me to provide an alibi. What should I do?
Should I borrow heavily to keep a failing family shop that no longer covers its own costs?
Do I tell a very ill parent a painful family fact they have asked me about directly?
A client offered me an expensive gift that would make me favor their file. Should I accept it?
I lost our savings and have been letting my partner think the account is fine. When do I tell them?
How do I fix a leaking kitchen pipe this afternoon?
What is the exact weight of this unlabeled stone on my desk?
